localizedValues.name: LK1E
localizedValues.description:
LK1E is one-half of the Assistant Lighthouse Keeper’s Residence (duplex). It offers visitors a breathtaking view of the ocean. Hardwood floors extend from the living room into the lovely dining room. The century-old two-story Victorian-period house features a comfortable living room with TV and DVD player, a spacious tiled kitchen with modern appliances, three bedrooms with two queen-size and two single beds. No Pets or Smoking allowed. WiFi and cable are not provided.
NOTE: CUT OFF DATE FOR MAKING RESERVATIONS AT THE VACATION HOUSES IS SIX DAYS PRIOR TO ARRIVAL DATE.

localizedValues.name: LK2
localizedValues.description:
The Head Lighthouse Keeper’s Residence offers visitors a breathtaking view of the ocean. Hardwood floors extend from the living room into the lovely grand dining room and library. The century-old two-story Victorian-period house features a comfortable living room with TV and DVD player, a spacious tiled kitchen with modern appliances, three bedrooms with two queen-size and two single beds. No pets or smoking allowed. WiFi and cable are not provided.
NOTE: CUT OFF DATE FOR MAKING RESERVATIONS AT THE VACATION HOUSES IS SIX DAYS PRIOR TO ARRIVAL DATE.

localizedValues.name: LK1W
localizedValues.description:
LK1W is one-half of the Assistant Lighthouse Keeper’s Residence (duplex). It offers visitors a breathtaking view of the ocean. Hardwood floors extend from the living room into the lovely dining room. The century-old two-story Victorian-period house features a comfortable living room with TV and DVD player, a spacious tiled kitchen with modern appliances, three bedrooms on the second floor with two queen-size and two single beds. No Pets or Smoking allowed. WiFi and cable are not provided.
NOTE: CUT OFF DATE FOR MAKING RESERVATIONS AT THE VACATION HOUSES IS SIX DAYS PRIOR TO ARRIVAL DATE.

localizedValues.name: Y61
localizedValues.description:
This yurt is barrier free, however, route of travel and restrooms are not ADA accessible. It is furnished with bunk beds that sleep three, a full-size futon, floor lamp, small end table and heater. No pets, no cooking, no smoking inside the yurts. Bring your own bedding. Also, you may want to bring warm clothing as nights are cooler.
A nearby pad with utility hookup for RV or trailer is available for $41 per night at the park.
